saw_lines: PC builders compare wattage, noise and warranty before buying a power supply, then keep it for years.
So the sale is won on the spec sheet. Buyers who cannot find noise and wattage fast leave for a rival.
Your 66 Google ads include 40 videos, so open each video with a customer quote and link the homepage to one review figure buyers can check before paying.
